records.manualArithmetic: NEW DRAFT: mg20N, m2kg and g10m/s² are consistent. With contact and zero acceleration perpendicular to a fixed straight plane, N-mg cos(theta)=0. At60deg N20/2=10N; at0deg N20N. Parallel support forces do not alter this perpendicular balance. Domain0..75 has0<N<=20; inverse m=10/(10*1/2)=2kg and cos(theta)=1/2 gives60deg uniquely there. Normal and weight act on the same body and are not an action-reaction pair. Actual consumer selects60/0, not unsupported40.
